name: iltizam
description: محفظة الالتزام للمشاريع للمقاولين — Compliance Vault (Frontend + API + PostgreSQL)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @iltizam/core --if-present && npm run build -w @iltizam/web && npm run build -w @iltizam/api && npm run build -w @nmwabran/portfolio
scripts.test: npm run test -w @iltizam/core && npm run test -w @iltizam/api && npm run test -w @iltizam/web && npm run test -w @nmwabran/portfolio
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @iltizam/core && npm run typecheck -w @iltizam/api && npm run typecheck -w @iltizam/web && npm run typecheck -w @nmwabran/portfolio
